items.headline: Beach Hazards Statement issued October 18 at 12:43PM PDT until October 20 at 9:00AM PDT by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...Dangerous rip currents and breaking waves. Surf of 3 to 6
feet with local sets to 7 feet, primarily for south-facing
beaches.

* WHERE...San Diego County Coastal Areas and Orange County
Coastal Areas. Highest waves on south and southwest facing
beaches.

* WHEN...Now through Tuesday morning.

* IMPACTS...There is an increased risk of ocean drowning. Rip
currents can pull swimmers and surfers out to sea. Waves can
wash people off beaches and rocks, and capsize small boats
nearshore.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...Minor beach erosion may occur across south-facing
beaches.
items.instruction: Remain out of the water to avoid hazardous swimming conditions.
